title: Route mapping and compact hub proposal — June 2024
content:
Goal
Draft a compact, keyboard-first console navigation pattern + canonical route matrix that (1) reduces vertical real estate, (2) supports role-scoped entry points, and (3) makes deep-linking and routing consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments. This is a working proposal for design review and grooming.

High-level constraints and assumptions
- Console must work in 3 contexts: Hosted tenant (single org), Dedicated (company tenant, multiple projects), Private (VPC; customer-managed domain). Routes should be stable across all.
- Primary users on first visit: engineers (ML infra, SRE), platform/product owners, solutions engineers. Fast path: open endpoint, check logs, rollback.
- Target: collapsed/compact sidebar by default for screens <1280px. Full labels available on hover or keyboard focus.
- URL scheme must be bookmarkable and support copy/paste share to Slack/PRs.

Design principles
1) Compactness: icons + 1–2 char indicator (badge) in collapsed state. Secondary labels appear on hover or when pinned open.
2) Predictability: canonical route skeletons; avoid duplicate content under different routes (use redirects/canonical headers).
3) Role-aware scoping: routes behave differently by role (viewer vs admin) but path stable, e.g., /org/:org/projects => shows projects or a scoped view.
4) Progressive disclosure: surface quick actions (create deployment, stream tail logs) inline with route hover.
5) Keyboard-first: a global command palette (Cmd+K) and arrow/letter-based nav in the sidebar.

Sidebar structure (compact-first) — suggested groups and microcopy
- Workspace hub (icon: grid): "Workspaces" -> /orgs/{org}/workspaces. Quick action: new workspace (w).
- Models (icon: cube): "Models" -> /orgs/{org}/models. Sub routes: /models/{model}/versions, /models/{model}/evals. Quick filters: quantized, fp16.
- Endpoints (icon: rocket): "Endpoints" -> /orgs/{org}/endpoints. Sub routes: /endpoints/{id}/deploys, /endpoints/{id}/metrics. Quick action: create endpoint (e).
- Deployments (icon: server): "Capacity" -> /orgs/{org}/capacity. Renders Dedicated pools and Private clusters together via tab.
- Observability (icon: graph): "Observability" -> /orgs/{org}/observability. Includes traces, traces/stream, eval dashboards. Shortcut: tail logs (t).
- Optimize (icon: wrench): "Optimize" -> /orgs/{org}/optimize. Suggestions, quant policy, batching.
- Security & Admin (icon: shield): "Settings" -> /orgs/{org}/settings. Admin-only features hide but route remains present with access denied messaging.
- Billing & Support (icon: wallet / life-ring): "Billing" and "Support" -> consistent top-level.

Sidebar states and interactions
- Collapsed (default on medium screens): icons only + small unread / alert badges. Hover over an icon expands a transient label panel (200ms delay) with actions and local keyboard hint (e.g., "e: new endpoint").
- Pinned/Expanded: full list with chevrons for groups. Group reordering saved to user prefs.
- Responsive: on very small screens (phone), replace sidebar with bottom nav and collapsed command palette.
- Accessibility: all items must have aria labels and focus ring visible. Keyboard nav: <Up>/<Down> to move, <Enter> to open, Space to open action menu. Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 to jump to top-level groups.

Canonical route matrix (draft)
- /orgs/{org} -> Dashboard hub (redirect to last-visited or Workspaces).
- /orgs/{org}/workspaces -> listing + create -> /orgs/{org}/workspaces/{w}/overview
- /orgs/{org}/models -> /models/{id}/versions -> /models/{id}/versions/{v}/inspect
- /orgs/{org}/endpoints -> /endpoints/{id}/deploys/{deployId}/metrics
- /orgs/{org}/capacity -> /capacity/pools/{poolId} (pool pages show Dedicated/private mapping)
- /orgs/{org}/observability/logs -> /observability/traces/{traceId} -> /observability/alerts/{alertId}
- /orgs/{org}/optimize/suggestions -> suggestion/{id}/review
- /orgs/{org}/settings -> settings/teams -> settings/teams/{id}/roles

Routing rules and edge cases
- Canonicalization: /models/:id and /orgs/:org/models/:id should redirect to a single canonical path (choose /orgs/:org/models/:id). Avoid duplicate entries in the nav.
- Back-compat: support legacy routes under /projects/* for 6 months with 301 -> new paths.
- Deep link behavior across deployments: private deployments may have different hostnames; links must include org id and path only. Client should resolve base host via tenant config.
- Missing privileges should return a compact placeholder with CTA to request access rather than a 404.

Wireframe notes (visuals to create)
- Small canvas sketches: pinned collapsed + transient hover panel; command palette open over center; endpoint details page with secondary rail for deploy controls.
- Microinteraction: when hovering an endpoint in the collapsed nav, show a tiny inline "tail logs" button that opens a bottom sheet. No navigation change.
- Badge rules: red for critical alerts, orange for warnings, blue for suggestions. Badges only show number when >0; otherwise dot.

Backlog grooming — tasks (rough priority)
- PRD: finalize route skeleton and permission model (JIRA: PRJ-482) — P0 (Owner: Raj)
- Design: produce 3 wireframe variants (compact, grouped, hybrid) — P1 (Noor) -> deliverables: hi-fi + interaction spec
- Engineering: client-side routing infra refactor to support tenant base resolution + legacy redirects (JIRA: WEB-337) — P0 (Miguel)
- Backend: add canonical route header + redirect middleware for legacy routes (JIRA: API-111) — P1 (backend)
- QA: keyboard nav test harness + a11y audit (task: QA-keys-001) — P1
- Metrics: add an instrumentation event for "nav_jump" and "command_palette_open" (ANALYTICS-44) — P2

Risks and open questions
- Performance: expanded transient hover panels may cause layout shift — need to evaluate repaint cost and consider portal layering.
- Complexity: supporting role-scoped content with single path might require server-side view gating; do we prefer client-side feature gating?
- Private deploy link resolution: if customer hostnames differ, is it okay to expose only path-level links in copy-to-clipboard? (Pros: portable, Cons: extra resolution step).
- Migration: how do we communicate to customers the change in left-rail behavior? Need an in-console guided tour.

Next steps
- Groom backlog with ENG/Design/PM this week (add action owners in JIRA)
- Design to produce interactive prototype for keyboard nav and hover microinteractions by 2024-07-12
- Engineering spike: measure layout cost of transient hover panels by 2024-07-05

Appendix — example microcopy for hover panel
- Title: "Endpoints"
- Line 1: "Open endpoints overview" (Enter)
- Line 2: "Create endpoint (e)" (Quick action)
- Footer: "Press Cmd+K to jump anywhere"

Links and references
- Confluence: console-ia-redesign (CONFLUENCE-1234)
- Past reference: left-rail-reorg-hypotheses (see google drive)
- Slack thread: #console-ia (pins: route-matrix.png)

Notes to reviewers
- Looking for opinions on: (a) collapsed hover latency (200ms?) (b) whether Admin-only items should be visually muted or hidden entirely (c) canonical path preference for models (/models/:id vs /orgs/:org/models/:id).
- Please add comments inline in this doc or link PRs/Confluence pages. Thanks.
